comments.text: hand-over from the crack's trainer: the first instruction of the game's own code, reached by JMP $0400 from the copy loop at $C60C
hardware IRQ vector ($FFFE) points here; saves A, X, Y and jumps through the pointer at $0408
NMI and reset vectors ($FFFA, $FFFC) point here; a bare RTI
screen-code text FALLS, the lives counter label on the status line
the four joystick-orientation messages, left-handed and right-handed for joysticks 1 and 2
BRUCE LEE and RON J FORTIER, drawn on the title screens
DATASOFT PRESENTS, first line of the menu screen
text "MICROPEARL MUSIC PLAYER COPYRIGHT 1983 JOHN A. FITZPATRICK", the credit for the sound routines around $EB00-$F100
